title: Elux Firerose 5000 Blueberry Pomegranate 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Pomegranate from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection presents a skilful fusion of two beloved flavours. The rich, sweet profile of jammy blueberries is perfectly paired with the tart, exotic flavour of pomegranate, creating a blend that is both invigorating and soothing. The blueberry brings a natural, mild berry sweetness, while the pomegranate offers a contrasting sharpness, resulting in a vape that is exquisitely layered and deeply satisfying. This combination of sweet blueberry and tart pomegranate creates a complex and enjoyable taste experience. Ideal for vapers who seek a blend that's both sophisticated in its flavour profile and memorable in its impact. The taste is reminiscent of a freshly made fruit juice, bursting with natural flavours and a hint of luxury. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
